title: Improve performance when posting credit memos by skipping unnecessary lookups on empty keys
summary: Credit memo posting now skips unnecessary table lookups when source keys are empty, improving performance for both purchase and sales credit memos without changing functional behavior.
key_points: Purch. Cr. Memo Line avoids full-key scans when Order No. is empty
Sales Cr.Memo Line exits early when Applies-to Doc. No. is empty
Prevents broad table scans during credit memo posting operations
Performance optimization maintains existing functional behavior
